title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Su’aal matixaayo iyo xad-xad ah qaybinta
bridge: Ingiriisi, su’aalka matixaayo ayaa amar ka badan la heli karaa erayada adagta (e.g., 'somewhat', 'arguably'), fiilka modalka qiyaastaynta (e.g., 'might', 'could'), iyo isticmaalka xukummada adagta (e.g., 'although', 'while'). Isku day in oo ah in Af-Soomaaliga, meesha ay subjunctives (had iyo ma aha) mid ka mid yihiin, Ingiriisiisu waad u badan tahay xadhigga erayada iyo calaamadaada natiijada. Khalad aan adag ahayn waa inaad u turjumiso xukummadka Af-Soomaaliga oo 'had iyo ma aha', Ingiriisiisu waxay u hadal fududeeya 'although it could be' ama 'while it might be'.
rule: Si aad u qaybisid su’aal matixaayo Ingiriisi degmeda C1, soo bandhig: 1) Erayada adagta (e.g., 'arguably', 'apparently', 'probably') inaad u muujinaysid qiyaastaynta hadalka. 2) Fiilka modalka imtixaanka (might, may, could) inaad u muujinaysid darajadaha yaqiin. 3) Xidhiidhka adagta (although, even though, while, whereas) inaad u soo bixisid khilaafad. 4) Xukummadka 'it could be argued that...', 'one might say that...', 'this is not to say that...' inaad u soo bixisid matixaayo. Fiirso xadhigga sintaksis: Ingiriisi, adaggu wuxuu ku noqonayaa hore ama dhexdhexaad, laakiin iskama qaybiyin mijaarta iyo fiilkiisa sida ay noqon kartaa Af-Soomaaliga. Isticmaali 'maybe' (adag) qiyaastaynimo xumaysan; dooro 'perhaps' ama 'possibly'.

concept_examples.text: Although it could be argued that the policy has benefits, its long-term effects remain uncertain.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii ay la soo bandhigayo in siyaasadda leh faa’iido, kala duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya weli ay ku jirtaan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɔːlˈðəʊ ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːɡjuːd ðæt ðə ˈpɒləsi hæz ˈbenɪfɪts, ɪts ˈlɒŋtɜːm ɪˈfekts rɪˈmeɪn ʌnˈsɜːtən/

concept_examples.text: While this approach seems reasonable, one might question its practicality in real-world scenarios.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan u maleynayo in tusaalehanu wanaagsan yahay, qof baa u gudba ka baxan karo ammaanka ee duniya haqiiqiga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /waɪl ðɪs əˈprəʊʧ siːmz ˈriːzənəbl, wʌn maɪt ˈkwestʃən ɪts ˌpræktɪˈkæləti ɪn rɪəl wɜːld sɪˈnɑːriəʊz/

concept_examples.text: The evidence is compelling; nevertheless, one should not overlook the counterarguments.
concept_examples.translation: Burburku waa adag; aan u baahanin inaan oggolaan khilaafadka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈevɪdəns ɪz kəmˈpelɪŋ; ˌnevəðəˈles, wʌn ʃʊd nɒt ˌəʊvəˈlʊk ðə ˈkaʊntərˌɑːɡjʊmənts/

concept_examples.text: It could be said that the proposal, though well-intentioned, fails to address the root cause.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa la yiri karayaa in tashriicdu, haddii ay u fiicnaan, ay ma qayb gelin tijaabada asalkiisa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd bi ˈsed ðæt ðə prəˈpəʊzəl, ðəʊ ˌwelɪnˈtenʃənd, feɪlz tu əˈdres ðə ruːt kɔːz/

common_error.wrong: Although it could be possible, but I doubt it.
common_error.correct: Although it could be possible, I doubt it.
common_error.correct_alt: It could be possible, but I doubt it.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga, waxay aman tahay in la isticmaalo 'had iyo ma aha' in la sii sheego adaggu, laakiin Ingiriisiisu ma aanu u ogolaan inaad u soo bandhigto 'although' iyo 'but'. Isticmaali midka keliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, 'had iyo ma aha' waxay u turjumaan 'although'/'though' bilowga hore, iyo 'but' waxay isticmaalaya in la soo bandhigo khilaafadka dabeecadka sare ee xukmadda.

examples.original: Arguably, the most significant factor is economic stability.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɑːrɡjuəbli, ðə məʊst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈfæktə ɪz ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk stəˈbɪləti/
examples.translation: Waxaa la yiri karayaa in shaxsiyadda ugu muhiimsan yahay isticmaalka lacagta.
examples.note: 'Arguably' waxay ku noqonayaa hore ama dhexdhexaad, Af-Soomaaliga waxay u eg tahay 'waxaa la yiri karayaa'.

examples.original: The results are presumably accurate, but we need to verify them.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑː prɪˈzjuːməbli ˈækjʊrət, bʌt wi niːd tu ˈverɪfaɪ ðəm/
examples.translation: Natiijada waxay u maleyn tahay adag, laakiin waa inaan ubad u bixinno.
examples.note: 'Presumably' waxay soo jeedaa qiyaas ahaan; ha iska xiraamo 'probably'.

examples.original: Apparently, the committee has reached a consensus.
examples.phonetic: /əˈpærəntli, ðə kəˈmɪti hæz riːʧt ə kənˈsensəs/
examples.translation: Adag, talada ayaa la heli karay.
examples.note: 'Apparently' waxay soo jeedaa in wax ay u eg yahay run sida ay ku jiraan burburku la heli karo.

examples.original: She might have overlooked the details, but the overall conclusion is sound.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt hæv ˌəʊvəˈlʊkt ðə ˈdiːteɪlz, bʌt ði ˈəʊvərɔːl kənˈkluːʒən ɪz saʊnd/
examples.translation: Ayay ku timaad inay iska ilaalin xusuusadka, laakiin wareega sare ee ku guuleystay.
examples.note: 'Might have + participio' waxay soo jeedaa imtixaanka ee hore.

examples.original: The data could be interpreted differently if we change the assumptions.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə kʊd bi ɪnˈtɜːprɪtɪd ˈdɪfrəntli ɪf wi ʧeɪnʤ ði əˈsʌmpʃənz/
examples.translation: Baaruuru waxay u qiyaastay inay u fahmi karo kala duwan haddii aynu beddelno qiyaastayd.
examples.note: 'Could' waxay soo jeedaa imtixaanka shartiga.

examples.original: The project may succeed if the funding is secured.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɒʤekt meɪ səkˈsiːd ɪf ðə ˈfʌndɪŋ ɪz sɪˈkjʊəd/
examples.translation: Shaqada waxay u nacab sanaysid haddii lacagta la haystayo.
examples.note: 'May' waxay adag tahay; Ingiriisiisu hadalka waxay dooran 'might' ama 'could'.

examples.original: Even though the plan is flawed, it offers a starting point for discussion.
examples.phonetic: /ˈiːvən ðəʊ ðə plæn ɪz flɔːd, ɪt ˈɒfəz ə ˈstɑːtɪŋ pɔɪnt fɔː dɪˈskʌʃən/
examples.translation: Haddii ay tijaabadu leeyihiin khilaafad, waxay bixisaa bilowga hore ee niyaysiga.
examples.note: 'Even though' waxay u adag tahay 'although'.

examples.original: Whereas some experts advocate for reform, others warn against it.
examples.phonetic: /weəˈræz sʌm ˈekspɜːts ˈædvəkeɪt fɔː rɪˈfɔːm, ˈʌðəz wɔːn əˈɡenst ɪt/
examples.translation: Haddii ay xaqiiqdii waxay ku talin tahay isbeddel, qaar baa ka dugan tahay.
examples.note: 'Whereas' waxay isticmaalaya in la soo bandhigo fikrad ebedsan xukummadka sare ee xukmadda.

examples.original: However compelling the argument may be, we must consider the practical implications.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈevə kəmˈpelɪŋ ði ˈɑːɡjʊmənt meɪ bi, wi mʌst kənˈsɪdə ðə ˈpræktɪkəl ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz/
examples.translation: Haddii ay su’aalkii adag yahay, waa inaan u fiirino kala duwanaanshaha ammaanka.
examples.note: Xukmadda 'However + adjective + subject + verb' in la matixaayo.

translations.so: Su’aal matixaayo iyo xad-xad ah qaybinta

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Waxbarashada iyo Taageerada Fikradaha
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, aan ku dhexeeyo inaan u sheegno taageerada waxbarashada la isticmaalayo awoodaheena 'waxaan u maleynayaa', 'waxa ay muhiimsan yihiin in la sheego' ama subjunctive. Af-Ingiriisi, waxaa jira wareegga in la qabto fiidmooyinka modal (may, might, could) si loo soo baxo xaqiiqda, fiidmooyinka dareenka (highly, somewhat, arguably) iyo awoodaheena ra'yiga aan la qaadan karin (It is worth noting). Khalad aad u adag waxaa ah in la isticmaalayo 'must' wax kastoo af-Soomaaliga 'waxa ay noqon lahaa', markaasaa af-Ingiriisi 'must' waxay u muujisaa qiyaastii aqoonnimo aad u sarreeya, aan ahayn suuragal. Waxa ugu muhiimsan ahna waxaa loo isticmaalaya in la soo baxo xagga aan la qaadan karin: af-Ingiriisi waxaa la isticmaalaya 'I would argue' kala duwan 'I think definitely'.
rule: Si aad u taageersato waxbarashada af-Ingiriisi degmada C1, isticmaal: 1) Fiidmooyinka modal si loo baxo xaqiiqda: 'must' (xaqiiqda), 'may/might/could' (suuragal), 'can't' (aan suuragalno). 2) Fiidmooyinka dareenka: 'highly', 'extremely', 'somewhat', 'arguably', 'undoubtedly'. 3) Awoodaheena aan la qaadan karin: 'It is worth noting that...', 'It could be argued that...', 'The evidence suggests...'. 4) Fiidmooyinka ra'yiga: 'I would argue', 'I contend', 'I maintain' (waa uun formal ka badan 'I think'). 5) Kala soocida: 'however', 'nevertheless', 'whereas'. Ka tiraa isticmaalada badan 'I think' qoraalka aqoonnimo; dooro 'This implies that...' ama 'It could be inferred that...'. Taageerada, isticmaal 'strengths and weaknesses', 'implications', 'limitations'.

concept_examples.text: While the author makes a compelling case, the argument fails to address the economic implications.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii intaasoo macallimihu qudusho aad u fiican u bixiyo, qudhusta ma uu sheego suuragalkii qiimaynta.
concept_examples.phonetic: waɪl ði ˈɔːθər meɪks ə kəmˈpelɪŋ keɪs, ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt feɪlz tə əˈdres ði ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪkl ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz

concept_examples.text: It could be argued that the proposed solution is not sustainable in the long term.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa la sheekaysaa in halligga la soo bandhigay ma ay noqon doontaa diyaarinta muddo dheer.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjud ðæt ðə prəˈpoʊzd səˈluːʃən ɪz nɑːt səˈsteɪnəbl ɪn ðə lɔːŋ tɜːrm

concept_examples.text: The evidence suggests that the policy has had limited impact, if any.
concept_examples.translation: Diliyada waxay u muujisaa in siyaasaddu waxay leeyihiin taathir aad u yar, haddii ay tahay.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈevɪdəns səˈdʒests ðæt ðə ˈpɑːləsi hæz hæd ˈlɪmɪtɪd ˈɪmpækt, ɪf ˈeni

concept_examples.text: One might question the validity of the study, given its small sample size.
concept_examples.translation: Qof baa u gudsaa xaqiiqda baahana, xaaladdu waa inay leedahay munaaraddii yar.
concept_examples.phonetic: wʌn maɪt ˈkwestʃən ðə vəˈlɪdəti əv ðə ˈstʌdi, ˈɡɪvən ɪts smɔːl ˈsæmpəl saɪz

common_error.wrong: I think that the author is right, but the article is not good because it doesn't have examples.
common_error.correct: While the author makes a valid point, the article would be stronger if it included concrete examples.
common_error.correct_alt: Although the author's argument is plausible, the lack of specific examples weakens the overall analysis.
common_error.explanation: Kuwa af-Soomaali ah ayaa u jeeda inay tarjumaadaan si toos ah 'I think' iyo inay isticmaalaan sawir aad u xun. Af-Ingiriisi aqoonnimo, waxaa la sugayaa in la soo baxo 'would', 'could', 'arguably' iyo in la ka jirto xukummooyin khaatiyah 'not good' (waa uun aan u adag). Si kastaba ha isticmaal 'while/although' si loo soo baxo kala duwanaanta iyo 'would be stronger if' si loo soo baxo tashriihyo.

examples.original: This may not be the most effective approach.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs meɪ nɑːt bi ðə moʊst ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈproʊtʃ
examples.translation: Tegnaan wuxuu noqon maayo dhammaan u fiican.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'may' suuragal. Xusuuso in af-Soomaaliga waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa 'waa la yaabi'aan inay noqon doontaa', laakiin af-Ingiriisi ma isticmaalin subjunctive.

examples.original: The results could be interpreted in several different ways.
examples.phonetic: ðə rɪˈzʌlts kʊd bi ɪnˈtɜːrprɪtɪd ɪn ˈsɛvərəl ˈdɪfərənt weɪz
examples.translation: Natiijada waxaa la tafsiri karayaa kala duwanaanto badan oo kala duwan.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'could' kala duwan 'can' si loo baxo xagga aan la qaadan karin iyo formal.

examples.original: It would seem that the hypothesis lacks sufficient support.
examples.phonetic: ɪt wʊd siːm ðæt ðə haɪˈpɑːθəsɪs læks səˈfɪʃənt səˈpɔːrt
examples.translation: Waxaa u maleynayaa in go'aanka ma ay leedahay diyaarsan aad u fiican.
examples.note: Qoradha 'It would seem that' waa uun formal ka badan iyo adag 'it seems'.

examples.original: The argument is compelling, yet it overlooks crucial evidence.
examples.phonetic: ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt ɪz kəmˈpɛlɪŋ, jɛt ɪt ˌoʊvərˈlʊks ˈkruːʃəl ˈɛvɪdəns
examples.translation: Qudhusha waa fiican, laakiin waxay ka hadhashaa diliyada muhiimsan.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'yet' kala duwan 'but' si loo baxo dareenka aad u sarreeya.

examples.original: This approach has significant limitations, particularly in terms of scalability.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs əˈproʊtʃ hæz sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˌlɪmɪˈteɪʃənz, pərˈtɪkjʊlərli ɪn tɜːrmz əv ˌskeɪləˈbɪləti
examples.translation: Tegnaanka waxay leeyihiin xanuunyo aad u badan, xaaladdu waa inay tahay xanuunyo dareenka.
examples.note: Tijaabi colocations ku filan: 'significant limitations', 'key weaknesses', 'notable strengths'.

examples.original: The research is groundbreaking, but its scope is rather narrow.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈriːsɜːrtʃ ɪz ˈɡraʊndbreɪkɪŋ, bʌt ɪts skoʊp ɪz ˈræðər ˈnæroʊ
examples.translation: Baahintha waxay cusbayn tahay, laakiin dareenkii waa aad u yar.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'rather' kala duwan 'muy' si loo baxo xagga aan la qaadan karin.

examples.original: While I concede that the data is limited, I maintain that the pattern is still relevant.
examples.phonetic: hwaɪl aɪ kənˈsiːd ðæt ðə ˈdætə ɪz ˈlɪmɪtɪd, aɪ meɪnˈteɪn ðæt ðə ˈpætərn ɪz stɪl ˈrɛləvənt
examples.translation: Haddii aan u qaado in diliyada ay yaraadeen, waxaan isku haysaa in xaaladu weli uu muhiimsan yahay.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'while' si loo baxo qaabka ugu horeeya iyo markaas u sheego ra'yigaaga 'I maintain'.

examples.original: It could be argued that the policy is outdated; however, it still provides a useful framework.
examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjud ðæt ðə ˈpɑːləsi ɪz ˌaʊtˈdeɪtɪd; haʊˈɛvər, ɪt stɪl prəˈvaɪdz ə ˈjuːsfəl ˈfreɪmwɜːrk
examples.translation: Waxaa la sheekaysaa in siyaasaddu ay noqotay qaawana; laakiin weli ay u fiicnaa qaab aad u fiican.
examples.note: Ku xiraa 'It could be argued that' 'however' si loo baxo kala duwanaanta.

examples.original: Despite the opposition, the proposal merits serious consideration.
examples.phonetic: dɪˈspaɪt ði ˌɑːpəˈzɪʃən, ðə prəˈpoʊzəl ˈmɛrɪts ˈsɪriəs kənˌsɪdəˈreɪʃən
examples.translation: Haddii la qaado khilaafadda, waxaa lahaa in ay u fiicnaan diiwaangelinta aad u fiican.
examples.note: Tijaabi inaad isticmaashid 'despite + noun' (aan ahayn 'despite of').

title: Irony and Understatement / Caydhnimo, qalad iyo eufemism
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, caydhnimadu iyo qaladdadu waxay ku noqon kartaa inay la qoran yihiin qalab iyo abuur lexica ah oo badan (sida 'waad og tahay', 'waa adag yahay', 'sidee baan u qaadan karaa'), waxaana badan oo la isticmaalayo magaca qaybaha (diminutives) ama magaca badan (augmentatives). Af-Ingiriisi, caydhnimadu waxay ku dhacdaa badan oo la isticmaalayo qalab la'aan iyo erayada iftiimiska ah, eufemismase waxaa loo isticmaalayaa qalab cultural oo badan si loo xanuuniyo waqi af badan. Taffaara: Af-Ingiriisi, inaad ku qaybiso ('understatement') waa taar ka mid ah caydhnimadu (inad dhahdo 'not bad' si aad u sheegto 'excellent'), waxaana u adag inay la qaybiso qofka Af-Soomaali ah oo aan ogayn, waxayna ku tashan qaybinta la qoray ('no está mal'), ku darna qaybinta. Haddana, fiirso: qaladdadu Af-Ingiriisi waxay u eg yahay inay noqoto qalad badan oo ka badan Af-Soomaali, waxaana u adag in la doortama erayada si loo oggolaado qalad.
rule: Af-Ingiriisi darejadda C1, caydhnimadu iyo eufemismadu waxay ku dhacdaa: 1) Understatement: isticmaal adjektif ama adverb oo ku saabsan dareenka si aad u sheegto mid ka soo jeeda (sida 'It's not the worst idea' = 'waa fikrad adag'; 'a bit' ama 'slightly' waxa ay u qaadan kartaa maana la soo jeeda). 2) Qalad: waxay ku noqon kartaa qalab iyo qalab (la'aan ama badan), laakiin waxay ku noqon kartaa qalab sida 'Oh, great!', 'Well, that's just perfect' ama 'I love it when...'. 3) Eufemism: beddel erayada adag oo erayada iftiimiska ah (sida 'passed away' oo ah 'died', 'let go' oo ah 'fired', 'between jobs' oo ah 'unemployed', 'full-figured' oo ah 'fat'). Qalabka ugu horreysa: adverb oo ku saabsan dareenka ('hardly', 'barely', 'scarcely') oo ah understatement; su'aasha retorika ('Is that so?') oo ah caydhnimadu; qalab oo la isticmaalayo 'just', 'only', 'a bit' oo ah qalab. Tijaab: qalabka caydhnimadu iyo qaladdadu ma ay noqon karaan qalabka oo dhan; qalabka rasmi ah, qaladdadu furan waxay ka hadhashaa. Eufemismadu waxay ku noqon kartaa qalabka oo ka soo jeeda: qalabka shaqaalaha waxay ku noqon kartaa badan. Arta Soomaaliga: iska ilaa inaad beddela qaybinta 'no está mal' (ma ay noqon karin understatement Af-Ingiriisi, waxay u eg yahay inay noqoto qalad), isticmaal 'not too bad' ama 'not bad at all' oo la qoro qalabka u eg.

concept_examples.text: That's a bit of an exaggeration, don't you think?
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa jira qiyaastii aan u qalin lahayn, ma aysan u maleyn?
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə bɪt əv ən ɪɡˌzædʒəˈreɪʃən, doʊnt juː θɪŋk/

concept_examples.text: The weather is not exactly tropical here.
concept_examples.translation: Dabyooladu halkan ma ahayn adag u dhaxaysan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈweðər ɪz nɒt ɪɡˈzæktli ˈtrɒpɪkəl hɪər/

concept_examples.text: He's been known to stretch the truth occasionally.
concept_examples.translation: Waa la ogaa inuu u qaybiyo runta mararka qaarkood.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiːz biːn noʊn tə strɛtʃ ðə truːθ əˈkeɪʒənəli/

concept_examples.text: Well, that's just perfect!
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa badan oo adag. Mid ka mid ah shirka oo dhan ee isku halleeyay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɛl, ðæts dʒʌst pərˈfɛkt/

common_error.wrong: No está mal, ¿eh? (como respuesta a algo excelente, literal translation)
common_error.explanation: Khalaadadu waxay ka soo baxaa qaybinta 'no está mal' oo Af-Soomaali ah. Af-Soomaali, 'no está mal' waxay noqon kartaa mid positif ama mid negatif oo la qoro qalabka, laakiin Af-Ingiriisi 'not bad' oo aan la qoro qalabka waxay u eg yahay inay noqoto qalad. Si aad u sheegto understatement positif, waa inaad ku darto 'at all' ama isticmaal 'not half bad', waxa ay u qaadan yihiin 'adag u fiican'. Haddana, fiirso qalabka: Af-Ingiriisi, waxaa badan oo la isticmaalayo qalab la'aan ama ku qaybinta si loo sheego caydhnimadu.

levels.label: Understatement with adverbs of degree
levels.translation: Hoos u qaybisay adverb oo ku saabsan dareenka

examples.original: I'm a bit confused about the instructions.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ə bɪt kənˈfjuːzd əˈbaʊt ði ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz/
examples.translation: Waan qalad badan oo aan u fahmo qalabka.

title: Indirect Speech Acts and Implicature / Shaxaanada Hadladda iyo Implicaturas
bridge: Faransiiska, shaxaanada hadladda aan xaga jirayn ayaa badan la qoraa inay la qoraan ama inay la qoraan '¿Me pasas la sal?' waxay u egtaan. Ingiriishi, xishooda aan xaga jirayn waxay u adag tahay oo badan la qoraa inay la qoraan fiilka modal (could, would), su'aasha aan la qabin, oo dhammaan qoraalka (I was wondering) inay u adkaan talada. Kuwa Faransiiska hadlaya waxay u adag tahay inay Ingiriishi hadlayaan, waxaana u egtaa inay qoraan ama inay qoraan. Hadana, implicaturas hadladda (inferencias) waxay u adag tahay inay la qoraan; Ingiriishi, waxaa la sugayaa inay la qoraan inay la qoraan, laakiin qoraalka waxay u adag tahay.
rule: Shaxaanada hadladda aan xaga jirayn Ingiriishi waxay u adag tahay inay la qoraan: 1) Su'aasha 'can/could/would you...' inay taladaan (Could you close the window?), 2) 'I was wondering if...' inay taladaan (I was wondering if you could help me), 3) Su'aasha aan la qabin inay taladaan ama inay taladaan (Don't you think it's too late?), 4) 'It might be a good idea to...' inay taladaan. Implicaturas, waxaa la qoraa inay la qoraan Grice; misaal, 'I'm cold' waxay u egtaan inaad rabto inaad fuusad. C1, waxaa la sugayaa inay la qoraan.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Qoraalka iibimada rasmiga ah
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, waxaan ku tiiman inaan isticmaalno qalab-dhisme kuxiran 'haddii aad u dheer', 'qalab kale' ama 'dhammaadka' si ay u qalab-dhismeen hadalka. Af-Ingiriisiga, qoraalka wuxuu u badnaa inuu noqdo si taxaddar leh iyo si qiyaastii, qalab-dhisme kuxiran 'firstly', 'furthermore', 'but more importantly', iyo 'in light of this'. Khalad aad u tiiman waxaa ah tarjumadka adag 'on one side' 'on the one hand', ama isticmaal 'in conclusion' meesha aan labada dhibcadda 'to sum up' ama 'ultimately' isticmaalno. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isticmaalka abuurka rasmiga ah iyo uunka jumbadaha waxay ka farqaysaa: Af-Ingiriisiga waxaa u jeclaa jumbado si cad leh iyo si qallafsan leh, waxaase af-Soomaaliga ay u jeclaa inuu noqdo si aan la qalbin karin.
rule: Iibimada rasmiga ah af-Ingiriisi (C1), waxaa la sugan in lagu isticmaalo qalab-dhisme iyo qoraal si ay u qalab-dhismeen hadalka si jabi leh iyo si aan la qalbin karin. Intii bilowga, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa jumbado 'I would like to begin by...', 'Let me start by...', ama 'The purpose of this presentation is to...'. Intii xilka, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'Firstly', 'Secondly', 'Furthermore', 'Moreover', 'In addition'. Intii kala duwanaanta, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'However', 'On the other hand', 'Nevertheless'. Intii ku xidhan, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'Indeed', 'In fact', 'It is important to note that'. Intii dhammaadka, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'In conclusion', 'To summarize', 'In light of the evidence'. Waxaa inoo la yaabaa inaanan isticmaalno qalab-dhisme (sida 'it's' meesha 'it is') iyo abuurka aan rasmiga ahayn. Waxaa mid aan la yaabin inaan isticmaalno 'we' (sida 'we can see that...'). Intii codka iyo xadhigga, waxaase aan noqon karin qiyaastii, waxaa mid aan la yaabin inay noqoto si ay u fiicniyaan. Qoraalka rasmiga ah, waxaa lagu jeclaa in lagu isticmaalo qiyaastii iyo qoraalka aan la qalbin karin si ay u hadlato xaaladaha, iyo qoraalka shaki si ay u hadlato go'aamooyin.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Xarunta iyo Xawaarinta Qoraalka Akadeemiga ah
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, kuwa hadla ayaa adeegsan yihiin qaabka subjunctive iyo erayada 'laxan' ama 'waa la keydiyay' inay u xaruntaan, laakiin qoraalka Ingiriiska akadeemiga ah, xarunta wuxuu ku guuleystaa adag oo dhan oo ku salaysan fariin qalabka (modal verbs), erayada adag (adverbs of probability), iyo fariin raayi (verbs of opinion) sida 'suggest' ama 'appear'. Khalad aad u adag waa tarjumaadka adag 'waa la keydiyay in' in 'it is possible that', waxay u shaqaynayaa laakiin ma aha inay ku soo baxdo adag oo dhan oo ku salaysan qalabka 'may' ama 'could'. Waxaad u qaatayaa inaad u dhaqso inaad xaruntaan adag: qoraalka Ingiriiska akadeemiga ah waxaa loo doondoonaa xaqiiq iyo miyir, ma aha xarunta adag.
rule: Qoraalka Ingiriiska akadeemiga ah, waxaa la isticmaalaa calaamo xarunta (hedging) inay u xaruntaan gooyaamiyeyaasha iyo inay diidaan gooyaamiyeyaasha adag. Deegaankii ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay: 1) Fariin qalabka: may, might, could (e.g., 'This may indicate...'), 2) Erayada adag: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (e.g., 'This possibly suggests...'), 3) Fariin raayi: suggest, appear, seem (e.g., 'The data suggest that...'), 4) Tilmaamaha aan shakhsi ahayn: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Xawaarinta (boosting), waxaa la isticmaalaa erayada adag sida clearly, undoubtedly, definitively, ama fariin sida prove, demonstrate. Waxaad u qaatayaa inaad aan u madaaxdo xarunta iyo xawaarinta: tilmaam sida 'This clearly may be true' waa khalad ah maxaa yeelay waxay u khilaafsan yihiin xarunta. Qoraalka Ingiriiska akadeemiga ah, waxaa lagu diidaa isku-shubka shakhsi 'I' qaabka badan, oo lagu dooro qalabka aan shakhsi ahayn.

common_error.wrong: This may clearly show the problem.
common_error.explanation: Khaladku wuxuu yahay in la xirto xarunta (may) iyo xawaarinta (clearly), waxaana u abuurayaa khilaaf adag. Af-Soomaaliga waxaa adeegsan yahay in la sameeyo (e.g., 'waxan u muujin kartaa xaqiiq'), laakiin qoraalka Ingiriiska akadeemiga ah, waxaad u qaatayaa inaad doortid midkood. Inaad diidid khalkadan, u adeegso haddii aad u sheegto in aad u sheegto (istaadhif may, might, could) ama aad u sheegto (istaadhif clearly, undoubtedly, demonstrates). Inaad u madaaxdo waxay u confusion qaataa qaraaga iyo waxay u qaataa iman.

title: Advanced Negotiation Strategies / Isticmaalka Fara-warshad ee Fara-warshad
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, markii aan u wada hadalno, aan u adag noqonaynaa inaan isticmaalno qoraallada oo si toos ah ama kalamka xadka ah oo 'waxaan ku soo bandhigayaa' ama 'ma aha noo kelin'. Ingiriisi, fara-warshadka fara-warshad wuxuu u dhexeeyaa inuu isticmaalo fiil-fiilsan (would, could, might), jumlayaasha shartiga ah, iyo luqadda aan si toos ahayn inay u fududeeyaan iyo inay u tixraacaan khayraad. Ingiriisi-na wuxuu isticmaalaa 'unless' iyo 'provided that' si uu soo baxayo shuruudaha, qoraallada aan lahaan mid la mid ah Af-Soomaaliga, waxa ayuusan u qadin doonaan khalad ah ee turjubinta. Waxaa la mid ah isticmaalka magacyada 'I was wondering if' marka laga qayb galayo su'aasha si toos ah, waxa uu Af-Soomaaliga u eg yahay inuu noqdo si aad u adag oo loo turjumo si toos ah.
rule: Si aad u wada hadashid degmada C1 Ingiriisi, ku qab isticmaalka waxa ku jira: 1) Isticmaalka shuruudaha (koowaad, labaad, saddexaad) si aad u soo bandhigto suuraagallada xaaladda: 'If we were to extend the deadline, we would need a discount'. 2) Fiil-fiilsan si aad u soo bandhigto adag iyo xanuun: 'I would suggest', 'We could consider', 'I might be open to'. 3) Jumalada dhaqanka iyo isbedelka 'although', 'however', 'while' si aad u soo bandhigto hardhexdhexaad ama aragtida kala duwan. 4) Hadiyadda luqadda iyo isku dayinta: 'meet you halfway', 'a win-win situation', 'bottom line'. 5) Shuruudaha 'unless', 'provided that', 'as long as' shuruudaha rasmiyada ah: 'We can agree, provided that you cover shipping costs'. 6) Su'aasha aan si toos ahayn inay u tixraacaan xumaan si aan u adagayn: 'I was wondering if you would consider a different payment schedule'. Muhiim: ha isticmaalin 'I want' si badan; isticmaala 'I would like' ama 'We are looking for'. Khilaaf: qalabka wada hadashada adag (hard negotiation) waxaa laguu sii adag karaa in lagu si toos ah u hadalo, laakiin daimaan adag. Fiirso turjubinta si toos ah ee Af-Soomaaliga 'ma ay idinku qalbi lahayn' 'I don't like it' - Ingiriisi wuxuu u fududeyaa 'I'm not entirely comfortable with that'.

concept_examples.text: If we were to agree to a lower price, we would expect faster delivery.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan qaano aan u yar yahay, waxaan filan lahaa inaan soo dirno si degdeg ah.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː wɜːr tə əˈɡriː tə ə ˈloʊər praɪs, wiː wʊd ɪkˈspekt ˈfæstər dɪˈlɪvəri/

concept_examples.text: We could consider a discount, provided that you place a larger order.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u fikiri karnaa khasmaynta, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay inaad soo bixisaan shaxda badan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt, prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt juː pleɪs ə ˈlɑːrdʒər ˈɔːrdər/

concept_examples.text: I was wondering if you might be open to extending the payment terms.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan ku tashaday inaad u adag tahay inaad fashaan muddada bixinta lacagta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf juː maɪt biː ˈoʊpən tə ɪkˈstendɪŋ ðə ˈpeɪmənt tɜːrmz/

concept_examples.text: Unless we receive a commitment, we cannot proceed with the deal.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan helin isku dayinta, ma naga noqon doono inaan sii wadno qaybta shaqaalaha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ənˈles wiː rɪˈsiːv ə kəˈmɪtmənt, wiː ˈkænɒt prəˈsiːd wɪð ðə diːl/

common_error.wrong: I want that you reduce the price.
common_error.correct: I would like you to reduce the price.
common_error.correct_alt: We were hoping you could reduce the price.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadkan waxaa ka yimid turjubinta si toos ah ee Af-Soomaaliga 'waxaan rabnaa inaad yeshaan qiimaha'. Ingiriisi, 'want' markuu dhexeeyo ma isticmaali 'that + subjunctive' laakiin 'to + infinitive' ama 'somebody to do something'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wada hadashada adag, waxaa laguu dooran yahay 'would like' ama 'we were hoping' si aad u adag iyo adag. Ka beddel turjubinta Af-Soomaaliga iyo isticmaal 'wish + infinitive' ama 'would like + object + infinitive'.

examples.original: We might be willing to lower the price if you increase the order volume.
examples.phonetic: /wiː maɪt biː ˈwɪlɪŋ tə ˈloʊər ðə praɪs ɪf juː ˈɪnkriːs ðə ˈɔːrdər ˈvɑːljuːm/
examples.translation: Waxaan u adag nahay inaan yeshaan qiimaha haddii aad badhisaa tirada shaxda.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'might' si aad u soo bandhigto suuraagal iyo 'be willing to' si aad u soo bandhigto adagga shartiga ah.

examples.original: We can agree to a 5% discount, but only if you commit to a contract for two years.
examples.phonetic: /wiː kæn əˈɡriː tə ə faɪv pɜːrˈsɛnt ˈdɪskaʊnt, bʌt ˈoʊnli ɪf juː kəˈmɪt tə ə ˈkɒntrækt fɔːr tuː jɪrz/
examples.translation: Waxaan u adag nahay inaan qaano 5% khasmaynta, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay inaad isku dayaan muddada laba sano.
examples.note: Qoraalka 'can agree' + 'but only if' si aad u sharti furto dhaqanka.

examples.original: We would be prepared to extend the deadline provided that you pay a deposit.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wʊd biː prɪˈpeərd tə ɪkˈstend ðə ˈdedlaɪn prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt juː peɪ ə dɪˈpɒzɪt/
examples.translation: Waxaan u adag nahay inaan fashay muddada haddii aad bixisaan lacag-dhexdeeda.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'provided that' sharti rasmi ah.

examples.original: Our bottom line is that we cannot go below 10% margin.
examples.phonetic: /aʊər ˈbɒtəm laɪn ɪz ðæt wiː ˈkænɒt ɡəʊ bɪˈləʊ tɛn pɜːrˈsɛnt ˈmɑːdʒɪn/
examples.translation: Xaddigan waa inaan karin inaan ka yareyno 10% midabka.
examples.note: 'Bottom line' waa hadiyad luqadda ee muhiimka ah ee wada hadashada si aad u xisaabin doonto xaddiga.

examples.original: I'm afraid that offer is not acceptable to us.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt ˈɒfər ɪz nɒt əkˈseptəbl tə ʌs/
examples.translation: Waxaan ka baqayaa inay soo bandhigay ma aha wax aan u qalbin lahayn.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'I'm afraid' si aad u fududeeyaan diida.

examples.original: We are not in a position to make any further concessions.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr nɒt ɪn ə pəˈzɪʃən tə meɪk ˈɛni ˈfɜːðər kənˈsɛʃənz/
examples.translation: Ma naga noqon doono inaan siinay dhaqan kale.
examples.note: Jumalka rasmi ah 'not in a position to' si aad u diiddo adag.

examples.original: If you agree to these terms, we will sign the contract today.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː əˈɡriː tə ðiːz tɜːmz, wiː wɪl saɪn ðə ˈkɒntrækt təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Haddii aad isku dayaan shuruudahaas, waxaan subaxda aan qaadan doonnaa sharciiga.
examples.note: Sharti koowaad si aad u soo bandhigto bandhigga xaaladda.

examples.original: Let's shake on it and finalize the agreement.
examples.phonetic: /lɛts ʃeɪk ɒn ɪt ænd ˈfaɪnəlaɪz ði əˈɡriːmənt/
examples.translation: Dhammaan qaybta iyo dhammaan qaybta waxaan dhammaan qaybta.
examples.note: Hadiyadda 'shake on it' waa aan si toos ah u hadalno iyo aan si toos ah u hadalno inaan isku dayo.

examples.original: We look forward to concluding this partnership successfully.
examples.phonetic: /wiː lʊk ˈfɔːwəd tə kənˈkluːdɪŋ ðɪs ˈpɑːtnərʃɪp səkˈsɛsfəli/
examples.translation: Waxaan ku filan lahaa inaan dhammaan qaybta shaqaalaha.
examples.note: Jumalka rasmi ah si aad u dhammaan qaybta si aad u adag.

examples.original: Provided that we resolve the logistics issues, we have a deal.
examples.phonetic: /prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt wiː rɪˈzɒlv ðə ləˈdʒɪstɪks ˈɪʃuːz, wiː hæv ə diːl/
examples.translation: Haddii aan helin xaaladda logistics, waxaan lahaa shaqaalaha.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'provided that' ee dhammaan qaybta si aad u isku dayo shuruudaha dhammaan.

title: Nuanced Expression of Attitude / Jeeska jeeska iyo xukunka qalabka
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, waxaan ku adag noqonaynaa inaan jeeska jeeska u soo bixinno adverbi iyo qalabka qalabka (sida 'waa inaan u maleynayo', 'sidey aan u fiirayo'). Af-Ingiriisiga, adverbi iyo fiiri, waxaa la isticmaalaa fiil modal oo 'would', 'might', 'may' iyo qalabka 'I'd say' ama 'I'd argue' in la qalabiya ama la xoogjiyo arraacaddii. Khalad aad u adag ah wuxuu yahay 'I believe that' si adag u turjumaya 'waa inaan u maleynayo' qalabkaas oo ah qofka afkaas oo loo isticmaali doonaa modal ama adverbi 'arguably' ama 'presumably'. Waxa uu u eg yahay si adag u turjumaya ama si adag u turjumaya. Su'aasha waxay tahay in la ogaado si loo qalabiyeyo xaqiiqta oo loo isticmaaliyo shirka fiil modal, adverbi degree iyo qalabka aan la qalin Karin.
rule: Af-Ingiriisiga, jeeska jeeska iyo xukunka qalabka C1, waxaa la isticmaalaa: (1) Fiil modal (may, might, could, would, should) oo ah ay u soo bixiyaan imtixaanka, ogolaanshaha, soo jeestaha ama shartiga; (2) Adverbi jeeska (arguably, admittedly, typically, surprisingly) oo ay u soo bixiyaan xaqiiqta ama jeeska hadalka; (3) Qalabka aan la qalin Karin (It's fair to say, It could be argued that) oo ay u soo bixiyaan arraacaddii; (4) Fiil arracaddii qalabka (I'd suggest, I'd maintain, I'd contend) 'would' in la qalabiya. Kala duwan, waxaa la isticmaalaa 'not' + 'at all', 'hardly', 'scarcely' in la qalabiya. Waxaa in la ogolaanay in la isticmaalo 'I think' ama 'I believe' aan la qalin Karin. Hadalka rasmi ah, waxaa la doonayaa 'It would seem that' ama 'It might be argued'.

concept_examples.text: Admittedly, the results were not as impressive as we had hoped.
concept_examples.translation: Runta waa in la ogaado in natiijada aan ay u fiican yihiin sida aan u fiirnay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ədˈmɪtɪdli, ðə rɪˈzʌlts wəː nɒt æz ɪmˈpresɪv æz wiː hæd həʊpt/

concept_examples.text: One could easily argue that the policy has more drawbacks than benefits.
concept_examples.translation: Qof baa u macaan gelin lahaa inuu u qayshayo in siyaasadda waxay leedahay khasaaro badan oo badan oo badan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌn kʊd ˈiːzɪli ˈɑːɡjuː ðæt ðə ˈpɒlɪsi hæz mɔː ˈdrɔːbæks ðæn ˈbenɪfɪts/

concept_examples.text: I'd be inclined to say that the market will recover by next quarter.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan idinku soo sheego in suuqa wuxuu soo noqon doonaa muddada dambe ee toddoba bilood.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd biː ɪnˈklaɪnd tə seɪ ðæt ðə ˈmɑːkɪt wɪl rɪˈkʌvə baɪ nekst ˈkwɔːtə/

concept_examples.text: It's fair to say that both sides have made valid points.
concept_examples.translation: Waa in la ogaado in labadaba waxay bixiyeen xukumo xumanta ah.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts feə tə seɪ ðæt bəʊθ saɪdz hæv meɪd ˈvælɪd pɔɪnts/

common_error.wrong: I believe that the project is too expensive, but I think that we should do it.
common_error.correct: I'd say the project is rather expensive, but I'd still argue that we should go ahead with it.
common_error.correct_alt: One could argue that the project is too costly, yet I'd maintain we should proceed.
common_error.explanation: Khaladda waxay ka soo baxday in la isticmaalo 'I believe' iyo 'I think' si adag u turjumaya iyo si adag u turjumaya, oo af-Ingiriisiga waxay u eg tahay si adag u turjumaya iyo aan la qalin Karin. C1, waxaa la sugayaa in hadalka uu qalabiyeyo jeeska 'would' (I'd say), midabka 'rather', iyo fiilka 'argue' ama 'maintain'. In aad la ogolaan khaladda, waxa uu u eg yahay in la turjumo jeeska, aan la turjumo midabka: haddii af-Soomaaliga aan u dheheen 'waa inaan u maleynayo', af-Ingiriisiga waxaa laguu dheji doonaa 'I'd venture to say'. Kala duwan: 'I'm inclined to believe', 'I'd be tempted to say'.

examples.original: That might be the case, but we need more evidence.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt maɪt biː ðə keɪs, bʌt wiː niːd mɔːr ˈevɪdəns/
examples.translation: Waa la ahaa in ay noqoto, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay dalil kale.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'might' in la soo bixiyo imtixaanka oo aan xaqiiq ahayn. Af-Soomaaliga waxaa la isticmaalaa 'might', laakiin ha iska ilaa inaad isticmaashisid 'may' si adag: 'might' waxay u eg tahay si adag u turjumaya imtixaanka.

examples.original: I would argue that the benefits outweigh the risks.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈɑːɡjuː ðæt ðə ˈbenɪfɪts ˌaʊtˈweɪ ðə rɪsks/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan idinku soo sheego in faa'iidooyinka waxay u badanaadaan khasaarada.
examples.note: 'Would' waxay u qalabiyeysaa xukunka iyo jeeska shartiga. Af-Soomaaliga, shartiga 'jeclaan lahaa' waxay leedahay isticmaal kale oo la mid ah.

examples.original: It could be said that the approach lacks originality.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd biː sɛd ðæt ði əˈproʊtʃ læks ˌɔːrɪdʒˈnæləti/
examples.translation: Waa la ahaa in la yidhaahdo in qalabka aan la qalin Karin.
examples.note: Qalabka aan la qalin Karin 'could' waxay u eg tahay si aan la qalin Karin in la soo bixiyo xukunka. Af-Soomaaliga waxaa la isticmaalaa 'se' aan la qalin Karin, laakiin af-Ingiriisiga waxay u eg tahay qalabkan.

examples.original: Admittedly, my first impression was wrong.
examples.phonetic: /ədˈmɪtɪdli, maɪ fɜːst ɪmˈpreʃən wɒz rɒŋ/
examples.translation: Waa in la ogaado in arraacaddaygu hore waxay ahaayd khalad.
examples.note: Adverbi 'admittedly' waxay u soo bixiyaa ogolaanshaha oo ah jeeska runta. Af-Soomaaliga, waxaa laguu turjumaa 'waa in la ogaado in' ama 'runta'.

examples.original: The results were surprisingly consistent.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts wəː səˈpraɪzɪŋli kənˈsɪstənt/
examples.translation: Natiijada waxay ahaayeen si adag u turjumaya oo adag.
examples.note: Adverbi xukunka 'surprisingly' waxay u soo bixiyaan jeeska hadalka oo ay u hor tahay midabka. Xusuuso in af-Ingiriisiga koma aan la isticmaalo si adag u turjumaya af-Soomaaliga.

examples.original: I'm somewhat skeptical about the proposal.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈsʌmwɒt ˈskeptɪkəl əˈbaʊt ðə prəˈpoʊzəl/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan idinku soo sheego in waxaan u baahanahay inaan u maleynayo in soo jeestay.
examples.note: 'Somewhat' waa qalabka qalabka C1. Af-Soomaaliga, 'un tanto' ama 'algo' waxay u eg tahay midabka, laakiin ha iska ilaa inaad isticmaashisid 'somehow' (sida oo kale) meeshaas.

levels.label: Impersonal Constructions and Hedging
levels.translation: Qalabka aan la qalin Karin iyo qalabka

examples.original: It is widely acknowledged that the industry is changing.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli əkˈnɒlɪdʒd ðæt ði ˈɪndəstri ɪz ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ/
examples.translation: Waa in la ogaado in tijaabta waxay u badanaadaan.
examples.note: Qalabka 'It is + adverbio + participio' waxay u eg tahay hadalka rasmi ah. Adverbi 'widely' waxay u qalabiyeysaa xukunka aan la qalin Karin.

examples.original: One might venture that the strategy carries considerable risks.

examples.translation: Qof baa u macaan gelin lahaa inuu u qayshayo in khasaarada waxay u badanaadaan.
examples.note: 'One might venture' waa si rasmi ah in la soo bixiyo jeeska. Af-Soomaaliga, qalabka 'qof baa u macaan gelin lahaa' waxay u eg tahay midabka, laakiin af-Ingiriisiga waxay u eg tahay si rasmi ah.

examples.original: For the most part, the evidence seems to support the hypothesis.

examples.translation: Badan, dalilku wuxuu u eg yahay inuu soo baxayo xukunka.

title: Register Shifting / Beddelka registerka si aad u rabto xaaladda
bridge: Faransiiska, registerka wuxuu ku noqonayaa in la isticmaalo dumiyada adag oo 'tú' iyo 'usted' ama isku dhufanka fiilka. Ingiriishi, registerka ma uu soo jeedin fiilka, laakiin wuxuu u dhexeeyaa doorasho leh dareenka, xogta jumbada iyo isticmaalka codka isku xigeenka ama dumiyada. Kuwa afka Soomaaliga la hadla way niyeeyaan in ay u soo baxaan cod weyn oo xad gudub leh ama xad gudub leh oo aan la eg yirin xaaladaha, xusuusin in qoraalka u adeegsanayo. Waxaad u adagtahay inaad ku qabsato qaybaha qalabka adag (sida 'I was wondering if...') iyo 'hedging' ('might', 'could', 'perhaps') si aad u hesho register weyn oo xaalad leh.
rule:
Ingiriishi, registerka wuxuu u adeegaa xaaladda (xad gudub leh, adag, aan xad gudub leh) waxyaabaha asxaabta ah:

1. Dareenka: Ereymo adag iyo aan xad gudub leh (misaalka 'purchase' vs 'buy', 'receive' vs 'get', 'child' vs 'kid').
2. Sintaksis: Xogta jumbada weyn (jumbo la soo bandhigay, codka isku xigeenka) waxay u muujisaa adagga weyn; jumbo qaawan iyo la qoray waxay u muujisaa aan xad gudub leh.
3. Modaalo iyo hedges: 'Would', 'could', 'might', 'perhaps', 'possibly' waxay u qallafiyaan cod weyn iyo arraayo xaalad leh; xaaladaha aan xad gudub leh waxaa la isticmaalaa 'can', 'will', 'maybe'.
4. Fiilka soo jeestay: Waxay u egtaan inay noqoto aan xad gudub leh ama adag; registerka adag waxaa la doorto fiilka oo ka soo baxay Latin (misaalka 'to carry out' vs 'to execute').
5. Isbedelka: Waxaa la ekaadaa qoraalka adag (maa la isticmaali karo 'don't' laakiin 'do not').
6. Qaybaha qalabka: Warqadaha iyo iimaylkada adag waxaa la isticmaalaa qaybaha qalabka adag ('Dear Sir/Madam', 'Yours faithfully').
7. Dumiyada: Halgammadii aan u eg yirin adagga sida 'tú/usted', isticmaalka 'one' oo kale 'you' waxay u bixisaa cod aan xad gudub leh iyo adag (misaalka 'One must consider...').

Khilaafyo: Ingiriishka Britishka waxay u egtaan inay noqoto adag fiidka qaybaha qalabka ka badan Ingiriishka American. Isku dhufanka digitaalka aan xad gudub leh, waxaa la oggolaan in la isticmaalo luqadda qallafsan iyo emojicaadka, laakiin xaaladaha shaqaalaha waxaa in la ekaadaa.

common_error.wrong: Yes, I can help you with your project tomorrow, definitely.
common_error.correct: Yes, I would be happy to help you with your project tomorrow.
common_error.correct_alt: Certainly, I can help you with your project tomorrow.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadka ugu badan waxay tahay isticmaalka 'definitely' iyo xogta jumbada aan xad gudub leh xaaladaha adag. Kuwa afka Soomaaliga la hadla waxay u egtaan inay noqoto adag iyo isticmaalka dumiyada adag oo 'definitely' xaaladaha uu Ingiriishku u jeeda qaybaha qalabka adag iyo qallafsan. Iimayl adag ama shir shaqaalaha, 'definitely' waxay u egtaan inay noqoto adag. Waxaa lagama aanu isticmaalno 'I would be happy to' (waxaan ku faraxsanahay inaan) ama 'Certainly' (adag) oo ku soo bixisa cortesía iyo register weyn.

examples.translation: Dhammaan, helitaankayagu waxay u muujisaa fiican weyn.
examples.note: Marcadores discursivos oo leh 'In conclusion' waxay u egtaan inay noqoto qoraalka adag.

title: Pragmatic Styles in Cross-Cultural Communication / Istiilada Pragmatiga ee Isku-Xirka Soomaaliga iyo Luqadaha Kala duwan
bridge: Luqada Soomaaliga, adag iyo erayada aan la tulinayn waa la isticmaalaa si toos ah (istiicmaalka sharciga, qoraallada qalabka, iibsamayaasha). Ingiriisi, xususan qalabka u dhexeeyey iyo British, waxay u jeedaana dhammaadka erayada iyo dhammaadka sawirada by 'hedges' (dhammaadayaasha) iyo sharciga. Kuwaan soo hadalaya Soomaaliga waxay u dhexeeya inay isku halleeya si adag oo u adeegsan yare oo u adeegsan yare, waxaase Ingiriisi u fiicnaa qaybta iyo qaybta aan xumaan ahayn.
rule: Ingiriisi, adagga pragmatiga waxay la sameeyaa by: 1) Hedges ('sort of', 'kind of', 'I'd say'), 2) Fiicinnimada sharciga ee dhashay (would, could, might) in la qaybiyo go'aan, 3) Su'aalooyinka aan la tulinayn ama calaamadooyinka ('couldn't we...?'), 4) Qoraallada adagga by 'I'm afraid', 'I'd rather'. Soomaaliga, adagga waxay la heli karaa by sharciga ('an jeclaan lahaa', 'waxaad u baahan tahay'), laakiin waxay ku qalad tahay in la isticmaalo dhammaadayaasha erayada. Isku xishood, kuwaan soo hadalaya Ingiriisi waxay isticmaashaa 'I see your point, but...' sida qoraal la wanaagiyey, waxaase Soomaaliga 'an isku halleeyaa' waa la aqbalayaa. C1, isticmaala 'just' iyo 'actually' sida calaamadooyin adagga u beddela.

concept_examples.text: I'm afraid I can't agree with that proposal.
concept_examples.translation: An ka baqayaa inaan u adaggo tarankaas.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ kænt əˈɡriː wɪð ðæt prəˈpoʊzl/

concept_examples.text: Would you mind if I offered a different perspective?
concept_examples.translation: Ma iibsanaysid haddii aan soo bixayo fiirood caleeso?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʊd ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ ˈɔːfərd ə ˈdɪfərənt pərˈspektɪv/

concept_examples.text: Actually, I'd rather we didn't jump to conclusions.
concept_examples.translation: Runtii, aan jeclaan lahaa inaan aan naga dhaqanqo xukummo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli aɪd ˈræðər wi ˈdɪdnt dʒʌmp tə kənˈkluːʒənz/

concept_examples.text: Could we possibly schedule the meeting for next week instead?
concept_examples.translation: Sidee baa noo ka fiicnayaa inaan u soo bandhigoo shirka toddobaadka ee dambe?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli ˈʃedjuːl ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ fə(r) nekst wiːk ɪnˈsted/

common_error.wrong: I don't agree, this is a bad idea.
common_error.correct: I see your point, but I'm not sure that's the best idea.
common_error.correct_alt: I'd have to disagree with that, I'm afraid.
common_error.explanation: Soomaaliga, 'An isku halleeyaa, waa fikrad aan quudhin' waa adag oo la aqbalayo. Ingiriisi, adaggaas waxay u maleyn doontaa sida adag oo aan adag ahayn ama aan adag ahayn. Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa in la dhammaado isku xishood by 'I see your point' ama 'I'm afraid' si aan u xad gudbiyo xiriirka. Ka bedda negations oo aan la tulinayn; isticmaalo sharciga iyo dhammaadayaasha.

examples.original: That's sort of what I had in mind.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts sɔːrt əv wɒt aɪ hæd ɪn maɪnd/
examples.translation: Waxaas waa mid aan u adagayn inaan u maleynayo.
examples.note: 'Sort of' ma aha mid la mid ah 'aan u adagayn' by qalab la mid ah; waxay isticmaalataan si aan u adagayn ama aan u adagayn.

examples.original: I kind of feel we should reconsider.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ kaɪnd əv fiːl wi ʃʊd ˌriːkənˈsɪdər/
examples.translation: An ka baqayaa inaan u maleynayo inaan u maleynayo.
examples.note: Soomaaliga waxaad dhahaysaa 'an ka baqayaa', laakiin 'I kind of feel' waa dhammaad oo adag oo Ingiriisi ah.

examples.original: If you don't mind, I'd like to add something.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju dəʊnt maɪnd, aɪd laɪk tə æd ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
examples.translation: Haddii aad raalli gelisid, aan jeclaan lahaa inaan ku darso wax.
examples.note: Sharciga by 'if' waa mid oo ka mid ah Ingiriisi in la codso codsiga, ee la soo jeeda sharciga aan la tulinayn Soomaaliga.

examples.original: I'm not entirely convinced about that point.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt ɪnˈtaɪəli kənˈvɪnst əˈbaʊt ðæt pɔɪnt/
examples.translation: Anaan u maleynayo inaan u maleynayo qaybtaas.
examples.note: Soomaaliga waxaad isticmaalaysaa 'an u maleynayo', laakiin 'not entirely' waa midab oo adag oo Ingiriisi ah.

examples.original: With all due respect, I'd rather differ.
examples.phonetic: /wɪð ɔːl djuː rɪˈspekt, aɪd ˈrɑːðər ˈdɪfər/
examples.translation: By adag, aan jeclaan lahaa inaan u adaggo.
examples.note: Qoraal qalab oo badan oo la isticmaalayo isku dhafan; Soomaaliga waxaad amaraysaa 'by adag' oo aad u adagto isku xishood.

examples.original: I might be wrong, but I think this could be improved.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ maɪt bi rɒŋ, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðɪs kʊd bi ɪmˈpruːvd/
examples.translation: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan qalad ahay, laakiin aan u maleynayo in waxaas ay u fiicni doontaa.
examples.note: 'I might be wrong' waa dhammaad aan la mid ahayn Soomaaliga; waxay isticmaalataan in la dhammaado sawiradaaga iyo sawirada kale.

levels.label: Managing Face and Indirect Requests
levels.translation: Dhammaadka sawirada iyo codsiga aan xumaan ahayn

examples.original: I was wondering if you could possibly send the report by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju kʊd ˈpɒsəbli sɛnd ðə rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: An ka baqayaa haddii aad u fiicnayd inaad soo bixisid warbixin jimcaha.
examples.note: Isticmaalka sharciga ee dhashay ('was wondering') iyo 'possibly' in la dhammaado adagga ugu sarreeya. Soomaaliga waxay isticmaalayaan sharciga, laakiin aan u adagayn.

examples.original: Would you be open to a different approach here?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ju bi ˈəʊpən tə ə ˈdɪfrənt əˈprəʊtʃ hɪər/
examples.translation: Ma aad u adag tahay inaad u adagto qalab caleeso halkan?
examples.note: Qalabka 'be open to' ma aha mid la mid ah; waxay isticmaalataan in la tixraaco arraacinta aan u xad gudbeyn.

examples.original: I wonder if we could perhaps revisit this later.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwʌndər ɪf wi kʊd pəˈhæps ˌriːˈvɪzɪt ðɪs ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: An ka baqayaa haddii aad u fiicnayd inaan soo noqonno waxaas dambe.
examples.note: Tarta 'wonder', 'could', iyo 'perhaps' in la dhammaado si aan u adagayn. Soomaaliga, 'waxaa laga yaabaa' waxay isticmaalataan laakiin aan u adagayn qalabka rasmi ah.
